_comment: Hand-curated refinements merged over reflected output, keyed by 'artifactId:kind' then property. Each property may set: hide (drop), required, doc, format (path|host|port|url|millis). Reflection over-reports (internal container/ref setters) and can't infer required/docs; this is the curation surface. See design/connector-config-schema.md §3.1.

filename.doc: Path to the file to tail.

readStrategy.doc: How much of the file to replay on start.

cacheEventLog.doc: Retain published lines in memory for replay.

rotateOnSizeBytes.doc: Rotate when the file exceeds this many bytes; 0 = never.

maxBackupFiles.doc: Number of rotated backups to retain.

asyncWrite.doc: Flush writes on a background thread.
